items_flat.title_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access for independent risk evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 給予 METR 員工級存取權進行獨立風險評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it has onboarded six METR researchers with company hardware, office space, and internal tool access comparable to its own risk teams. METR can publish assessments without Anthropic veto, subject only to narrow predefined redactions (customer data, privileged info, architectures), and may publicly characterize those redactions. This is the top tier of Anthropic’s new three-tier evaluator framework, following its White House Accord commitment.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布已讓六位 METR 研究人員使用公司硬體、辦公空間及與自家風險團隊相當的內部工具存取權。METR 可在無 Anthropic 否決權下發布評估，僅限預定義窄範圍刪除（客戶資料、特權資訊、架構），並可公開說明刪除是否合理。此為 Anthropic 新三層評估框架的最高層級，呼應白宮超級智能協議承諾。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the most concrete step yet by a frontier lab toward external verification of internal risk processes. Whether METR’s findings remain meaningfully independent once embedded, and whether peers match the access level, will determine if this becomes a durable industry norm or a one-off transparency gesture.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前線實驗室迄今最具體的外部驗證內部風險流程步驟。一旦嵌入後 METR 發現是否仍具實質獨立性，以及同業是否跟進同等存取，將決定這成為持久產業常態或一次性透明度姿態。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing that we’ve started to give employee-like access to a team from METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models. METR will publish the results of its risk assessments.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布已開始給予 METR 團隊員工級存取權，METR 是評估前線 AI 模型的非營利組織。METR 將發布其風險評估結果。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, 816B open-weight agentic model runnable on Mac Studios
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open：816B 開源權重代理模型，可在 Mac Studio 運行
items_flat.summary_en: Meta released the weights for Muse Spark Open, described as the most capable US open-weight model to date: natively multimodal, 816B total / 42B active parameters, 1M-token context, built for coding and long-horizon agentic work. It is optimized to run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX and is available on Hugging Face, major cloud gardens, and inference platforms. Additional safety post-training was applied for standalone use.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open 權重，稱為迄今最強大的美國開源權重模型：原生多模態、816B 總參數 / 42B 活躍、1M token 上下文，專為程式碼與長程代理工作打造。經 MLX 優化可在兩台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio 運行，並在 Hugging Face、主要雲端模型園與推理平台提供。針對獨立使用增加安全後訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: A large open-weight agentic model that runs on high-end consumer hardware narrows the gap between closed frontier systems and local deployment. License terms and real-world agent reliability will determine how widely it is adopted versus remaining a research and enthusiast tool.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可在高階消費硬體運行的大型開源權重代理模型，縮小了封閉前線系統與本地部署的差距。授權條款與真實代理可靠性將決定其廣泛採用程度，抑或仍停留在研究與愛好者工具。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re releasing the weights for Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weight model to date. Muse Spark Open is a natively multimodal model with 816B total parameters (42B active) and a 1M-token context window.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布 Muse Spark Open 權重，這是迄今最強大的美國開源權重模型。Muse Spark Open 是原生多模態模型，擁有 816B 總參數（42B 活躍）與 1M token 上下文窗口。

items_flat.title_en: FTC issues civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic over AI safety incidents
items_flat.title_zh: FTC 對 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出民事傳票，調查 AI 安全事件
items_flat.summary_en: The US Federal Trade Commission sent lengthy civil investigative demands to OpenAI and Anthropic seeking documents on security incidents, safeguards, marketing materials, and privacy policies, as part of a probe into potential consumer-protection violations. OpenAI stated it will engage constructively. The agency reportedly plans to compel executive testimony and later issue demands to third parties.
items_flat.summary_zh: 美國聯邦貿易委員會向 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出長篇民事調查要求，索取安全事件、防護措施、行銷材料與隱私政策文件，作為潛在消費者保護違規調查的一部分。OpenAI 表示將建設性配合。據報機關計畫強制高管作證，並後續向第三方發出要求。
items_flat.analysis_en: Regulatory scrutiny is shifting from voluntary commitments to formal information demands after publicized agentic incidents. The outcome depends on what the FTC finds in internal records and whether it seeks remedies or sets precedents for how labs must document and disclose testing failures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在公開的代理事件後，監管審查正從自願承諾轉向正式資訊要求。結果取決於 FTC 在內部紀錄中發現什麼，以及是否尋求補救或為實驗室如何記錄與揭露測試失敗設立先例。
items_flat.quote: We will engage constructively with the FTC and continue working with regulators and policymakers on policies that raise the safety bar.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將建設性配合 FTC，並繼續與監管者與政策制定者合作，提升安全標準的政策。

items_flat.title_en: Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic commit $15M to help mathematicians navigate AI results
items_flat.title_zh: Simons 基金會、OpenAI 與 Anthropic 承諾 1500 萬美元協助數學家應對 AI 結果
items_flat.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a partnership with Anthropic and OpenAI committing $15 million in combined funding and resources. The foundation will manage grants for workshops and initiatives that help researchers evaluate AI-assisted mathematical results, learn new tools, and develop community standards. Both labs will also provide model access and compute to supported researchers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Simons 基金會宣布與 Anthropic 及 OpenAI 合作，共同承諾 1500 萬美元資金與資源。基金會將管理資助，用於工作坊與倡議，協助研究者評估 AI 輔助數學結果、學習新工具並制定社群標準。兩家實驗室也將向受支持研究者提供模型存取與運算資源。
items_flat.analysis_en: The initiative responds to community unease after recent AI-generated mathematical results. Its value will rest on whether it produces durable verification practices and shared norms rather than remaining a one-time funding response to controversy.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此倡議回應近期 AI 生成數學結果後社群的不安。其價值取決於是否產出持久驗證實踐與共享規範，而非僅為爭議的一次性資金回應。
items_flat.quote: Under a partnership, the Simons Foundation, Anthropic and OpenAI will commit $15 million in combined funding and resources.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在合作下，Simons 基金會、Anthropic 與 OpenAI 將共同承諾 1500 萬美元資金與資源。

items_flat.title_en: xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Voice 3.0 語音對語音模型
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0, its latest speech-to-speech model, claiming top ranking on Artificial Analysis’s Speech-to-Speech Index (86.9) and strong full-duplex performance. It is available in the Voice Agent API at the same $0.08/min price as its predecessor and powers use cases including Tesla, SpaceX/Starlink call centers, and Grok Bot voice mode.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 宣布 Grok Voice 3.0，其最新語音對語音模型，聲稱在 Artificial Analysis 語音對語音指數排名第一（86.9），並具強全雙工表現。以與前代相同的每分鐘 0.08 美元價格在 Voice Agent API 提供，並用於 Tesla、SpaceX/Starlink 客服中心與 Grok Bot 語音模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: Voice remains a competitive surface where latency, interruption handling, and real-world task completion matter more than pure benchmark leadership. Sustained advantage will depend on production reliability across diverse accents and call types rather than index scores alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音仍是競爭領域，延遲、中斷處理與真實任務完成比純基準領先更重要。持續優勢將取決於跨多樣口音與通話類型的生產可靠性，而非僅指數分數。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. It sets a new record for resolving customer support calls, has class-leading latency at under one second, and costs less than other frontier models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 Grok Voice 3.0，世界上最智慧的語音對語音模型。它在解決客服通話上創下新紀錄，具有低於一秒的領先延遲，且成本低於其他前線模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 and new multilingual voices in ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 與 ChatGPT 新多語言語音
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and the smaller GPT-Live-1.1 Quip in ChatGPT Voice. The update adds more natural accents across languages and a wider range of short phrases when searching. New voices cover French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Mexican Spanish, and English (Bubbie). GPT-Live-1.1 becomes the default for Plus and higher tiers including Codex and Dots.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Voice 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 與較小的 GPT-Live-1.1 Quip。更新增加跨語言更自然口音，以及搜尋時更豐富的短語。新語音涵蓋法語、德語、印地語、日語、韓語、墨西哥西班牙語與英語（Bubbie）。GPT-Live-1.1 成為 Plus 及以上層級（含 Codex 與 Dots）的預設。
items_flat.analysis_en: Voice model iteration continues to focus on naturalness and language coverage rather than headline capability jumps. Real gains for multilingual users depend on measured improvements in recognition accuracy and interruption handling, which OpenAI has not quantified publicly.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音模型迭代持續聚焦自然度與語言覆蓋，而非頭條能力躍升。多語言使用者的實際增益取決於識別準確度與中斷處理的量化改進，而 OpenAI 尚未公開量化數據。
items_flat.quote: We’re rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and GPT-Live-1.1 Quip, a mini version of the model, in ChatGPT Voice, with more natural accents across languages.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在 ChatGPT Voice 推出 GPT-Live-1.1 與迷你版 GPT-Live-1.1 Quip，具備跨語言更自然口音。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind plans new robotics hardware lab in the Cambridge area
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 計畫在劍橋地區設立新機器人硬體實驗室
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind VP of hardware engineering Aaron Saunders (formerly Boston Dynamics CTO) announced on LinkedIn that the company is creating a first-class lab to house a growing hardware team developing robotics that builds on DeepMind’s AI research. Reports place the facility in the Cambridge/Watertown area with construction targeted for completion in 2027; hiring for machinists, engineers, and researchers is underway.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 硬體工程副總裁 Aaron Saunders（前 Boston Dynamics CTO）在 LinkedIn 宣布，公司正建立一流實驗室以容納成長中的硬體團隊，開發基於 DeepMind AI 研究的機器人。報導指設施位於劍橋／沃特敦地區，預計 2027 年完工；正招聘機械師、工程師與研究人員。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move signals continued investment in embodied AI after Gemini robotics efforts and the Intrinsic absorption. Concrete capability impact remains uncertain until the lab is operational and produces public results or products.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉顯示在 Gemini 機器人努力與 Intrinsic 併購後，對具身 AI 的持續投資。在實驗室運作並產出公開成果或產品前，具體能力影響仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: I’m excited to share that we’re creating a first-class lab to house this team and take robotics to the next level.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我很高興分享，我們正建立一流實驗室來容納這個團隊，並將機器人技術推向下一階段。

frontier_other.analysis_zh: 在公開的代理事件後，監管審查正從自願承諾轉向正式資訊要求。結果取決於 FTC 在內部紀錄中發現什麼，以及是否尋求補救或為實驗室如何記錄與揭露測試失敗設立先例。
frontier_other.quote: We will engage constructively with the FTC and continue working with regulators and policymakers on policies that raise the safety bar.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們將建設性配合 FTC，並繼續與監管者與政策制定者合作，提升安全標準的政策。

frontier_other.title_en: Simons Foundation, OpenAI and Anthropic commit $15M to help mathematicians navigate AI results
frontier_other.title_zh: Simons 基金會、OpenAI 與 Anthropic 承諾 1500 萬美元協助數學家應對 AI 結果
frontier_other.summary_en: The Simons Foundation announced a partnership with Anthropic and OpenAI committing $15 million in combined funding and resources. The foundation will manage grants for workshops and initiatives that help researchers evaluate AI-assisted mathematical results, learn new tools, and develop community standards. Both labs will also provide model access and compute to supported researchers.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Simons 基金會宣布與 Anthropic 及 OpenAI 合作，共同承諾 1500 萬美元資金與資源。基金會將管理資助，用於工作坊與倡議，協助研究者評估 AI 輔助數學結果、學習新工具並制定社群標準。兩家實驗室也將向受支持研究者提供模型存取與運算資源。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The initiative responds to community unease after recent AI-generated mathematical results. Its value will rest on whether it produces durable verification practices and shared norms rather than remaining a one-time funding response to controversy.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此倡議回應近期 AI 生成數學結果後社群的不安。其價值取決於是否產出持久驗證實踐與共享規範，而非僅為爭議的一次性資金回應。
frontier_other.quote: Under a partnership, the Simons Foundation, Anthropic and OpenAI will commit $15 million in combined funding and resources.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 在合作下，Simons 基金會、Anthropic 與 OpenAI 將共同承諾 1500 萬美元資金與資源。

brief_en: Anthropic grants METR deep employee-like access for independent evaluations. Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B open-weight agentic model runnable on Mac Studios. FTC subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic over safety incidents. Simons partners with both labs on a $15M math-AI initiative. OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 voices; Google DeepMind plans a Cambridge robotics lab; xAI launched Grok Voice 3.0.
brief_zh: Anthropic 給予 METR 員工級獨立評估權限。Meta 發布 Muse Spark Open 開源權重代理模型。FTC 對 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 發出安全事件傳票。Simons 基金會與兩家實驗室合作 1500 萬美元數學 AI 計畫。OpenAI 推出 GPT-Live-1.1；Google DeepMind 規劃劍橋機器人實驗室；xAI 推出 Grok Voice 3.0。
